checks: only administrative location reaches the configured gateway, with no credentials or provider key
missing gateway or server key is not-configured and never falls back to another map provider
bounded successful results retain their unverified basis and generate only official Neshan point links
simultaneous same-city callers share a request and cancelling one does not cancel the other
last-consumer cancellation aborts obsolete city work and prevents stale cache writes
cache keys include gateway endpoint and city, with pacing and explicit refresh
failed transport, rate limit and oversized JSON stay distinct from successful empty results
snapshot uses one fixed local download across cities and never exposes city or health fields in its URL
cancelling one city preserves the shared snapshot consumer and configured live failures never use snapshot fallback
unconfirmed city, upstream invalid data and explicit Retry-After retain distinct recoverable errors
a hung gateway is aborted after twenty seconds and remains a retryable timeout
scope: Client contract and lifecycle with mocked gateway/local snapshot responses only. Actual collected snapshot and released UI are checked separately; this suite makes no live provider request.
